title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Error Schedule: Missing-Credit Time Fraction
content:
**Schedule rule.** For a notice that a Marlowe & Finch refund settled to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account has not been credited, the missing-credit time fraction follows the refund date — the date of the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund record settled to the card tender, as kept in the Merchandise Purchases records: when the refund was issued on the latest statement date or within the 30 calendar days before it, the fraction is the calendar days from the refund date to the latest statement date divided by 30; when the refund was issued after the latest statement date, the fraction is zero; when it was issued more than 30 calendar days before the latest statement date, it is one.

The latest statement date is the date of the account's most recent statement.

## Schedule

| Refund issued | Missing-credit time fraction |
|---|---|
| on the latest statement date or within the 30 calendar days before it | its days to the latest statement date, divided by 30 |
| after the latest statement date | zero |
| more than 30 calendar days before the latest statement date | one |

## Worked fractions (hypothetical latest statement dated 30 June)

| Merchandise Purchases refund dated | Days to 30 June | Fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 0 | 0 |
| 18 June | 12 | 0.4 |
| 31 May | 30 | 1 |
| 20 May | 41 | 1 |
| 5 July | after the statement date | 0 |
